team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Cloudfall Axiom: after the equipping character hits an opponent with a Plunging Attack, all nearby party members' Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 28% for 20s. (Energy regen to the equipping character from teammates' Plunging Attacks is not modeled.) Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A fan carved from pure jade, around which swirls an ancient aura of adeptal energy.

refinements.1: After the equipping character hits an opponent with a Plunging Attack, all nearby party members' Plunging Attacks will deal <r>28%</r> increased DMG for 20s. When nearby party members hit opponents with Plunging Attacks, they will restore <r>2.5</r> Energy to the equipping character. Energy can be restored this way every 0.7s. This energy regain effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.2: After the equipping character hits an opponent with a Plunging Attack, all nearby party members' Plunging Attacks will deal <r>41%</r> increased DMG for 20s. When nearby party members hit opponents with Plunging Attacks, they will restore <r>2.75</r> Energy to the equipping character. Energy can be restored this way every 0.7s. This energy regain effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.3: After the equipping character hits an opponent with a Plunging Attack, all nearby party members' Plunging Attacks will deal <r>54%</r> increased DMG for 20s. This energy regain effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.4: After the equipping character hits an opponent with a Plunging Attack, all nearby party members' Plunging Attacks will deal <r>67%</r> increased DMG for 20s. This energy regain effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.5: After the equipping character hits an opponent with a Plunging Attack, all nearby party members' Plunging Attacks will deal <r>80%</r> increased DMG for 20s. This energy regain effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.

fr.flavor: Un éventail sculpté dans du jade pur, autour duquel tourbillonne une ancienne aura d'énergie mystique.

refinements.1: Lorsque l'attaque plongeante du personnage équipé de l'arme a touché un ennemi, les DGT des attaques plongeantes de tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité augmentent de <r>28 %</r> pendant 20 s. Lorsque l'attaque plongeante d'un personnage de l'équipe à proximité touche un ennemi, le personnage équipé de l'arme récupère <r>2,5</r> pts d'énergie élémentaire. L'énergie élémentaire peut être restaurée une fois toutes les 0,7 s de cette manière. Cette restauration d'énergie élémentaire peut être déclenchée même si le personnage équipé de l'arme fait partie de l'équipe mais n'est pas déployé.
